`--modality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Modality to use.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"rna"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--layer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Layer in the AnnData object to use.

- If `attr` is 'X', this is the key in `.layers` to use. If not provided, `.X` is used.
- If `attr` is 'obsm', this is the key in `.obsm` to use.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The features to calculate autocorrelation for. Meaning depends on `--attr`:

- If `attr` is 'X' (default), this must be a list of gene names from `.var_names`.
  If not provided, it defaults to using genes in `.var['highly_variable']` (if present), or all genes.
  This behavior can be overridden by setting `--use_all_genes` to `true`.
  Note: You cannot pass a column name from `.var` here.
- If `attr` is 'obs', this must be a list of column names from `.obs`.
- If `attr` is 'obsm', this must be indices in `.obsm[layer]` (as strings).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `","`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obsp_neighborhood_graph`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in .obsp where spatial connectivities are stored.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"spatial_connectivities"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_all_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to use all genes even if highly variable genes are present in .var.
If set to true, all genes will be used.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/spatial_autocorr/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/feature_annotation/spatial_autocorr);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/spatial_autocorr/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
